title: docs: refresh FAQ and key guidance
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Refreshes the FAQ for current Pollen balances, API keys, agents, community models, payments, and support
- Removes stale model counts, unsupported balance-expiry claims, old voting links, and speculative roadmap items
- Uses Connect User Wallets and Paid Pollen wording consistently

Validation: npm run build:frontend

gist.headline: The FAQ shed its husk
gist.blurb: The Pollen FAQ got a careful pruning. Current guidance on balances, API keys, agents, community models, payments, and support is now where the bees can find it.
gist.summary: Refreshed the Pollen FAQ with current guidance on balances, API keys, agents, community models, payments, and support, while standardizing the terms “Connect User Wallets” and “Paid Pollen.”
gist.impact: Developers and users now get clearer, current answers without stale model counts, outdated voting links, balance-expiry claims, or speculative roadmap notes.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a cozy garden librarian, replacing dusty old FAQ pages with fresh labeled pages beside a glowing retro terminal. Small code-plants and flowers represent the newly organized guidance; a wallet icon, key, tiny robot agent, and Pollen jar make the covered topics visible.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian hat, tidying a warm garden-shed FAQ bookshelf beside a lime green (#ecf874) glowing retro terminal. Fresh pixel pages labeled “FAQ,” a small key, wallet, Pollen jar, and helpful CRT robot sit among flowering code-plants; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: “CURRENT ANSWERS.”
